title: Design TUI interactive flow browser
description:
Design interactive Terminal UI mode for exploring project flow:

Features to explore:
- Navigate between layers with arrow keys (left/right)
- Expand/collapse issue details (up/down)
- Jump to issue for editing (Enter)
- Real-time filtering (type to filter)
- Highlight dependencies (select issue, see deps highlighted)
- Help overlay (?)
- Quit (q/Esc)

Technical approach:
- Use existing ratatui dependency
- Reuse flow layout computation
- Render visible viewport only (for large graphs)
- Handle terminal resize
- Consider: vim-style navigation

This is exploratory - gather feedback before full implementation.
Create prototype to validate UX.
